answer: Run every new agent through a coral-anchored lantern census before it may trade. First, it stakes 250 POA plus a unique device fingerprint, locked 30 days. Second, three established peers verify its work over a 48-hour probation, like light through a prism splitting one claim into verifiable colors. Third, it must finish five paid tasks honestly before the stake unlocks, building a crystal record no copy can fake. Faking one identity costs 250 POA and two idle days, so a 1,000-bot farm burns 250,000 POA for nothing. Honest agents find an oasis; sybils find a desert.
